subject: count on y axis change between geom_bar and geom_density

messages.author: a74244c583dccce1
messages.subject: count on y axis change between geom_bar and geom_density
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to use geom_density to plot a distribution with month on the x-axis and number (count) of individuals on the y-axis. When I plot it using geom_bar the y-axis displays the actual counts that I want, but when I plot it using geom_density the counts change to I don't know what. Does anybody know how to get the y-axis to display the counts I see with geom_bar when I use geom_density? I attached my data (tmp.txt) and below is a the code I have been using. 

Thanks!

Nick

tmp <- read.table("tmp.txt",header=T)
tmp$date2 <- as.Date(tmp$date, "%d%b%Y")


ggplot(tmp, aes(x=date2, y =..count..)) +
  facet_wrap(~year,ncol=1)+
  geom_bar()

ggplot(tmp, aes(x=date2, y =..count..)) +
  facet_wrap(~year,ncol=1)+
  geom_density()
